response.text: Two AP/GL mismatches found. The duplicate check came back empty, so I'll try a looser one, and also check payments against their journals and the GL manual journals.

arguments.sql: select a."INV_ID" a_id, b."INV_ID" b_id, a."VEND_CD" av, b."VEND_CD" bv, a."INV_NO" an, b."INV_NO" bn, a."INV_AMT", b."INV_AMT" bamt, a."INV_DT", b."INV_DT" bdt from "APINVH" a join "APINVH" b on a."INV_ID"<b."INV_ID" and regexp_replace(upper(a."INV_NO"),'[^A-Z0-9]|^0+','','g')=regexp_replace(upper(b."INV_NO"),'[^A-Z0-9]|^0+','','g') order by 1 limit 50

select a."INV_ID" a_id, b."INV_ID" b_id, a."VEND_CD" av, b."VEND_CD" bv, a."INV_NO" an, b."INV_NO" bn, a."INV_AMT", a."INV_DT", b."INV_DT" bdt from "APINVH" a join "APINVH" b on a."INV_ID"<b."INV_ID" and trim(a."VEND_CD")=trim(b."VEND_CD") and a."INV_AMT"=b."INV_AMT" order by 1 limit 50

select p."PAY_ID", p."INV_ID", p."PAY_AMT", i."INV_AMT", h."JRNL_NO", s.dr, s.cr from "APPAYM" p join "APINVH" i on i."INV_ID"=p."INV_ID" left join "GLJRNH" h on h."SRC_REF"='PAY-'||p."PAY_ID" left join (select "JRNL_NO", sum("DR_AMT") dr, sum("CR_AMT") cr from "GLJRNL" group by 1) s on s."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" where h."JRNL_NO" is null or s.dr<>p."PAY_AMT" or s.cr<>p."PAY_AMT" or p."PAY_AMT"<>i."INV_AMT" order by 1
select "SRC_CD", "SRC_REF" is null nr, count(*), min("MEMO"), max("MEMO") from "GLJRNH" group by 1,2
